description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called WatchInboxView, which displays an inbox interface for a watch app. It shows a title, body, optional details, action buttons, status text, and update timestamp, based on data from a WatchInboxStore.

classes.name: WatchInboxView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders inbox messages with actions and statuses for watchOS.

methods.name: role(for:)
methods.description: Determines the button role (destructive, cancel, or nil) based on the styling string of a WatchPromptAction.
